legacy_cells.AJ: Clinical text preprocessing; named entity recognition; UMLS/SNOMED concept normalization; BERT-family contextual embeddings; TF-IDF vectorization
legacy_cells.AN: Expectation–maximization parameter estimation is used to address missing or uncertain data.
legacy_cells.BT: Probabilistic disease-diagnosis prediction; risk stratification; clinical-outcome prediction
legacy_cells.BV: Bayesian-network structure learning maximizes BIC; expectation–maximization estimates parameters.
legacy_cells.DQ: 2,653,149 clinical notes: 331,794 discharge summaries and 2,321,355 radiology reports
legacy_cells.EG: Reported training time: approximately 18–22 minutes per PRO run; inference time: less than 50 ms per patient. Scalability experiment: 2 minutes at 50,000 notes and 90 minutes at 2 million notes.
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with TF-IDF + Logistic Regression, SVM, BiLSTM, and ClinicalBERT; authors report NBO-CM had the best accuracy, F1, and AUROC, without numeric comparisons in the extracted prose.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablations remove NER, PRO-based structure learning, feature engineering, and preprocessing; reported full-model and ablation metrics are summarized in the evidence quotes.
legacy_cells.ER: Ethical review and approval were waived because the study used publicly available, de-identified MIMIC-IV clinical notes and involved no direct participant interaction.
legacy_cells.FR: The reported evaluation is retrospective and internal to MIMIC-IV; it does not demonstrate a persistent temporally evolving state, action-conditioned transition, causal identification, prospective benefit, or multisite validation.
legacy_cells.FT: Keep note-based diagnosis/classification distinct from a world model: the described pipeline maps extracted text features to Bayesian-network predictions but reports no evolving patient state or transition.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted 23-page PDF text read: title/abstract and introduction pp. 1–3; related work pp. 3–5; Methods §§3.1–3.6, pp. 5–14; Results and Discussion §4 with Tables 2–4 and Figures 3–8 discussion, pp. 14–20; conclusions, limitations, ethics, data availability, and code statement pp. 20–21; remaining back matter/references pp. 21–23. Figure content was available through extracted prose/captions rather than image inspection; Table 3 alignment was irregular in extraction and was not used beyond clearly stated timing values. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: No A:I prefilled metadata values were changed. Disease target/label construction, patient/test counts, temporal prediction horizon, exact feature discretization/checkpoint and uncertainty calibration are not reported; performance remains source-reported with uncertain task scope.

Figure7 right-axis tick labels visibly clipped in source; use prose for AUROC endpoints, do not infer missing labels. Table3 timing called indicative and future-tense parameter description coexists with implementation language.
Code availability contradicts Table3 future release vs p21 repository availability; no repository retrieval/code validation.
